title: Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters

monster.name: Medusith of the Unbroken String
monster.title: Queen of Sliding Boundaries
monster.defeatQuote: Your window expanded without a single collision...

description: Given a string `s`, find the length of the longest substring without repeating characters.

examples.explanation: The answer is "abc", with the length of 3.
The answer is "b", with the length of 1.
The answer is "wke", with the length of 3.

constraints: s consists of English letters, digits, symbols and spaces.
hints: Track the last seen index of each character in a Hash Map. When a duplicate appears inside the current window, shift the left pointer past it.
